g.text: py-app-sticker-raam-partner-klein | type sticker | trim 136 x 46 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: 22 printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: MarketingCampagne_ParkingYouPartner.pdf p1 (RGB (ICC), mock-up slide; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 136 x 46 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 142 x 52 mm.
Variabelen: line-1 = Parkeer slim bij; location-name = Hofplein

Snijcontour: groep cut-contour, spot ThruCut, 1 pt, 0.2 mm binnen de trim. Proposal: the mock-up shows no cut contour. The contour follows the outline of the grey sticker body, 0.2 mm inside the trim; radii measured on the body: upper pill 12.4 mm, lower pill 14.1 mm, bubble as the beeldmerk.

Window sticker small of the partner package, shown as a mock-up on the slide 'Partner pakket'. REAL SIZE IS A PROPOSAL: the slide has no dimensions; the grey body measures 48.5 x 16.4 mm at the slide scale 0.358 (poster 210 mm = 75.3 mm), so 135.5 x 45.8 mm real, proposed 136 x 46 mm (trim, 3 mm bleed). Layout: colour beeldmerk (left) on a

light grey base, two stacked pills: the upper one holds 'Parkeer slim bij', the lower one is white with the garage symbol and 'Hofplein'. Body: the light grey base is ONE flat shape, the beeldmerk bubble and the two pills merged (no blurred edge); in the file it sits in a 30 percent transparency group (#CCCCCE), which renders as #F0F0F0 and is read as

the sticker body, not as a shadow (owner to confirm; if the sticker is transparent or white instead, only the body colour changes). The template draws the body flat in #F0F0F0 (no token, observed) and 3 mm bleed as the outline moved outward.
